# OntoPlanet ontology package schema bundle 3.2.0

These are the canonical envelope, manifest, common, and six-family JSON
Schemas vendored from OntoPlanet
`packages/ontology-core/schemas/3.2.0/` at commit
`85529ad312664a9b5c18b53071a5f92feaba70fd`.

The upstream bundle manifest records the full bundle SHA-256 as
`0c7ee809a0049c2ae4baabbf672bcb412ed49a8380ab42ab1ecace32658b0d86`.
Agentic Operator intentionally vendors only the canonical admission schemas;
the separate import-normalization schemas are not an accepted package input.

Do not edit these JSON files locally. Update them together from one immutable
upstream bundle, verify every file against the upstream `manifest.json`, and
add explicit compatibility tests before admitting another bundle version.
